subject: Token velocity & perf proof — extension ask and capacity bump
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia@novusai.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Jul 2027 09:16:00 -0700
Subject: Early Q2 review — usage velocity & next-term timing

Alicia —

Quick readout from our side after pulling Q2 usage: tokens are up ~58% q/q driven by the new summarization flow you shipped in April. Latency headroom has been healthy but your 95th percentile for the long-tail requests crept from 320ms to ~470ms on the larger context jobs.

We know your renewal is coming up in August. Two asks from my side so we can present a clear recommendation to your CFO next week:

- Can you share a short ROI note from your product team describing the downstream lift (e.g., retention, NPS) you're seeing from the new feature? Even bullet points are fine.
- Would NovusAI be open to a 6-month extension on current terms with a committed burst capacity increase (reserve +10% baseline, with burst credits) so we can avoid throttling while you continue the rollout?

I'll attach our Q2 usage extract and the 95th latency slice so your infra folks can validate. Happy to jump on a quick call.

Thanks,
Markus Klein
Senior Account Exec — Renewals
Redwood Inference
attachments: Q2_Novus_usage_and_performance.pdf, 95th_latency_by_model.csv
From: Alicia Gomez <alicia@novusai.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Shah <samir.shah@novusai.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 10:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Early Q2 review — usage velocity & next-term timing

Markus —

Thanks for the note and for sending the extracts. Quick answers:

- I'll pull a short ROI bulleted doc from product by EOD Wednesday (we track retention lift and reduced manual review time; can quantify).
- We are sensitive to price increases but concerned about the latency for our conversational customers. A 6-month extension with a modest committed bump sounds reasonable to discuss.

A couple of requests from our side:
- Can you provide a one-pager that maps the proposed commit bump to expected latency SLO improvements and token unit economics? Our procurement wants to see delta-to-commit and projected overage risk.
- Please include a redlineable term amendment we can push through legal quickly.

Cc'ing Samir (ops) — Samir, can you validate the 95th numbers Markus shared?

—Alicia
Alicia Gomez
Head of Platform — NovusAI

Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2027 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Early Q2 review — Token velocity & perf proof — extension ask and capacity bump

Alicia / Samir —

Appreciate the quick validation. Per Alicia's ask, attaching a short one-pager and a proposed amendment. The one-pager ties the +10% baseline reserve + burst credits to: expected 95th latency reduction (projected drop from ~470ms to ~350ms for affected flows), estimated monthly token unit cost delta (net +7% on committed price — we modeled different delta scenarios), and overage exposure (projected <3% probability based on your last 90 days).

Summary of proposal (TL;DR):
- Term: 6 months extension to current term, same pricing band, add committed baseline +10% tokens, with 200k burst credits banked and 30-day usage smoothing.
- Operational: Redwood to prioritize NovusAI requests on the dedicated pool during identified surge windows; we will provide a shared dashboard and an SLA addendum for 95th latency monitoring.
- Legal: proposed-term-amendment.docx attached as a starting redline.

Next steps I suggest:
1) Alicia/Samir: confirm product ROI bullets (Alicia) and sign-off on technical feasibility (Samir).
2) Monica: can you prepare a quick cost delta table that maps commit+10% and burst usage to monthly invoice impact for Novus?
3) Ben: once we have ROI bullets, can you lead a one-page renewal memo to include with the amendment for exec review?

Happy to run a 30-minute review with Novus procurement Thurs afternoon.

Best,
Markus Klein
Senior Account Exec — Renewals
Redwood Inference
